title: A polynomial ring in any set of variables over an integral domain is an integral domain
statement: Let $D$ be an integral domain and $I$ any set. Then the polynomial ring $D[x_i]_{i\in I}$ in the variables $x_i$, $i\in I$ (finite $D$-linear combinations of monomials in finitely many of the $x_i$), is an integral domain. In particular $\mathbf Z[x_i]_{i\in I}$ is an integral domain and has a field of fractions.
